finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The code does not appear to involve any command execution or shell interpretation. The I2C register read operation is not vulnerable to command injection.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for any untrusted source feeding into a system-level command execution. No external input or environment variable is used in the snippet. The sink is Adafruit_I2CRegisterBits::read(), which performs a hardware register read, not an OS command invocation. No checks or sanitization are required for command injection. Thus the reported CWE-78 claim is a false positive.
